dispatcher_stuck: The dispatcher is stuck: there is free capacity and ready work, but two passes in a row started nothing.
worker_blocked: A worker is waiting for a permission nobody can give: {session}.
worker_died_twice: A worker stopped twice without finishing: {session}.
state_broken: The state file of {ap} is broken: {error}
two_answers: Two different answers arrived for {id}. Which one counts?
cap_warning: {active} autopilots are running but at most {cap} workers can run at once, so at least {waiting} has to wait.
state_one_at_a_time: Numbers unknown: one new worker at a time
stale: Usage numbers may be out of date.
no_report: No report yet. The first one comes at the next report time.
log_missing: This log is not on the page yet. It goes up with the next pass.
log_failed: Could not load this log: {error}. Close it and open it again to retry.
show_archive: Show archive (answered more than 7 days ago)
pending: Your answer is on its way.
handling_hint: Your answer reached the dispatcher. It is acting on it now.
read_only: You can read this page but cannot answer here.
empty_tasks: No tasks yet. They appear after the first pass.
unreachable: The data can't be reached yet, so what you see may be out of date.
signed_out: Sign in to claude.ai to see this page's data.
broken_banner: The state file of {ap} is broken. Run /autopilot doctor.
hero_gates: {n} more wait for a person to approve
hero_sub_none: The autopilot keeps going on its own.
self_hint: Routine calls it made and went ahead with. Nothing waits on them: OK marks one read, Undo reverses it.
pickup_minute: It is picked up within a minute.
pickup_later: It is picked up within {min} minutes.
pickup_paused: It is picked up when usage frees up.
cap_line: Up to {cap} workers at once · {active} autopilots active
parked_chip_unknown: Waiting for quota · resumes when usage drops
none_criteria: No acceptance criteria yet: the task's hand-back has not listed any.
none_screenshots: No screenshots: this task changed no UI.
none_logs: No logs: this task's evidence lists no log files.
none_rounds: This task had no PR review loop, so there are no review rounds yet.
none_links: No links: this task has no ticket and no PR yet.
sys_hint: A login or connection every pass needs. Each card closes by itself once a later check sees it working.
sys_checked: Last checked {when}. No answer needed: fix it, and the next check closes this card.
blocks_gh: Pushing branches, opening and merging PRs, and the merge check.
blocks_page: Publishing this page and reading your answers on it.
blocks_mcp: Every step that uses the {name} tools, such as syncing and moving tickets.
self_look: Decided by itself, worth a look ({n})
self_look_hint: It went ahead, but this one changes the scope or the spec, is hard to undo once merged, or changes what people see. OK if it stands, Undo if not.
self_remind: {n} decisions it made by itself are unread, the oldest from {when}.
self_task: Decided by itself in this task ({n})
hero_look: {n} of its own decisions are worth a look
explain_steps: Where it goes wrong, step by step
explain_related: How it ties to other cards
access_switch_note: Switching takes up to about 5 minutes (about 1 when a card is waiting).
access_key_error: Gateway key not working: {error}. New workers are paused.
access_key_fix: Run the key command in a terminal.
cap_card_body: Spent ${spent} of today's ${limit} limit. Running workers keep going. No new worker starts until you choose.
cap_pending: Answer sent: {answer}. It takes effect within a minute.
usage_unknown: Some cost could not be priced, so these numbers may be too low.
cap_card_body_unknown: Today's cost could not be priced, so no new workers start. Raise the limit or pause.
access_switch_note_quiet: Between {start} and {end} (this computer's clock) the next dispatcher pass applies it, within {min} minutes.
access_switch_note_off: The next dispatcher pass applies a switch, within {min} minutes.
cap_pending_off: Answer sent: {answer}. The next dispatcher pass applies it, within {min} minutes.
access_profile_error: Profile not working: {error}. New workers are paused.
access_profile_fix: Run `ap profile list`, then `ap profile use` with a profile that loads.
